## Motivation

What real failure or friction led to this? agents-kit's design is driven by failure modes that actually happened (see `BRIEF.md` / `SPEC.md`), so a concrete story is the strongest case: what you ran, with how many sessions, and what broke or felt clumsy.

## Proposal

What should happen instead? If it touches coordination behavior, note which parts are affected (`kit/agents` commands, `kit/PROTOCOL.md` rules, `install.sh`, ...).

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about — including working around it or doing nothing — and why they fall short.
